ts-skip-to-content: Link at the very top of every page, visible on keyboard focus, that jumps past the header to the page's content.
ts-search-placeholder: Placeholder of the search box in the global header. Search covers entity labels and aliases, and domain keys; page titles join when the site has pages (ADR 0010 §3).
ts-search-label: Accessible label of the search box in the global header.
ts-search-button:
Label of the button beside the search box.
{{Identical|Search}}
ts-search-title: Title of Special:Search, the full search results page (ADR 0010 §3), and the accessible name of its search form.
ts-search-intro: Shown on Special:Search before anything has been searched: what the search covers, and that an ID or domain jumps straight to its page.
ts-search-go-to:
Link above the search results to the entity page the search text names.

Parameters:
* $1 - the page title, for example "Item:Q42"
ts-search-no-entity:
Warning on Special:Search when the text is an entity ID or title and no such entity exists.

Parameters:
* $1 - the page title, for example "Item:Q999"
ts-search-none:
Shown when a search finds nothing.

Parameters:
* $1 - the search text
ts-search-group-item: Heading of the item results on Special:Search, and the filter link that shows only items.
ts-search-group-property: Heading of the property results on Special:Search, and the filter link that shows only properties.
ts-search-group-domain: Heading of the domain results on Special:Search (Domain:wikipedia.org and the like), and the filter link that shows only domains.
ts-search-more-item: Link under the first item results to all of them.
ts-search-more-property: Link under the first property results to all of them.
ts-search-more-domain: Link under the first domain results to all of them.
ts-search-matched-alias:
Under a search result that matched one of the entity's aliases rather than its label.

Parameters:
* $1 - the alias that matched
ts-search-filter-label: Accessible name of the links that narrow a search to one kind of entity.
ts-search-filter-all: Filter link on Special:Search that shows every kind of result.
ts-search-pages-label: Accessible name of the previous-page and next-page links of the search results.
ts-search-previous: Link to the previous page of search results.
ts-search-next: Link to the next page of search results.
ts-nav-label: Accessible name of the site navigation in the global header.
ts-nav-recentchanges:
Link in the global header to Special:RecentChanges.
{{Identical|Recent changes}}
ts-nav-jobs: Link in the global header to Special:Jobs, the list of import jobs (ADR 0010 §9).
ts-nav-specialpages:
Link in the global header to Special:SpecialPages.
{{Identical|Special pages}}
ts-new:
Label of the menu in the global header for creating items, properties and pages.
{{Identical|New}}
ts-new-item: Entry of the New menu that opens Special:NewItem.
ts-new-property: Entry of the New menu that opens Special:NewProperty.
ts-new-page: Entry of the New menu that creates a document page.
ts-login:
Link in the global header for a viewer who is not logged in.
{{Identical|Log in}}
ts-account: Link in the account menu to Special:Account, the account settings (ADR 0010 §11).
ts-account-menu:
Accessible name of the account menu button.

Parameters:
* $1 - the account's name
ts-account-userpage: Link in the account menu to the viewer's own user page.
ts-logout:
Link in the account menu that logs the viewer out.
{{Identical|Log out}}
ts-login-username: Label of the username field on Special:UserLogin.
ts-login-password: Label of the password field on Special:UserLogin.
ts-login-submit: Button that sends the login form.
ts-login-wrongpassword: Error on Special:UserLogin when the name or password is wrong.
ts-login-subsidiary:
Error on Special:UserLogin when the name is a subsidiary account (ADR 0024), which signs in only with a bot password.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name entered
ts-login-expired: Warning on Special:UserLogin or Special:UserLogout when the form's token no longer matches the session; the form is shown again with a fresh one.
ts-login-already:
On Special:UserLogin when the viewer is already logged in.

Parameters:
* $1 - the viewer's name
ts-login-continue:
Link back to the page the viewer came from.

Parameters:
* $1 - that page's title
ts-logout-question: On Special:UserLogout, above the button that logs out.
ts-logout-submit: Button on Special:UserLogout that logs out.
ts-logout-not-logged-in: On Special:UserLogout when no one is logged in.
ts-specialpages-login: On Special:SpecialPages, what Special:UserLogin is for.
ts-tabs-label: Accessible name of the row of tabs under a page's title.
ts-not-found-title:
Title of the page shown for an address the site has no page for.
{{Identical|Not found}}
ts-not-found: Body of the page shown for an address the site has no page for.
ts-api-unavailable-title: Title of the page shown when the site cannot reach the API.
ts-api-unavailable: Body of the page shown when the site cannot reach the API.
ts-api-too-old: Body of the page shown when the API reports an older api_version than the site needs (ADR 0057 §9).
ts-footer-powered:
Footer line on every page.
"Triplespace" is the software's name and is not translated.
ts-home-lead:
First line of the generated main page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the site's name
ts-home-search-label:
Accessible name of the search form on the generated main page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the site's name
ts-home-hint: Under the search box on the generated main page: what it finds, and that an ID or domain goes straight to its page.
ts-home-specialpages: Link on the generated main page to Special:SpecialPages.
ts-home-generated:
At the foot of the generated main page: why it is generated, and which page would replace it.

Parameters:
* $1 - the main page's title, for example "Project:Home"
ts-no-page:
The 404 page for a title the site has no page for.

Parameters:
* $1 - the title
ts-no-special-page:
The 404 page for a special page the site does not have.

Parameters:
* $1 - the title, for example "Special:Jobs"
ts-specialpages-search: On Special:SpecialPages, what Special:Search is for.
ts-specialpages-none: On Special:SpecialPages when the site offers none.
ts-api-unexpected: Shown when an API call a page needed returned something the site cannot read.
ts-permission-denied: Shown when the API refused the viewer the read right.
ts-entity-missing:
Body of the 404 page for an entity title.

Parameters:
* $1 - the title as requested
ts-tab-statements: Tab of an entity page (ADR 0010 §2): its statements.
ts-tab-identifiers: Tab of an entity page: its external identifiers.
ts-tab-sitelinks: Tab of an entity page: its sitelinks.
ts-tab-labels: Tab of an entity page: its labels, descriptions and aliases in every language.
ts-kind-item: Identity line of a local item's page: the kind of page.
ts-kind-property: Identity line of a local property's page.
ts-kind-property-datatype:
Identity line of a local property's page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the property's data type (one of the ts-datatype-* messages)
ts-kind-foreign-item:
Identity line of a foreign item's page (ADR 0010 §2).

Parameters:
* $1 - the provider's name, such as Wikidata
ts-kind-foreign-property:
Identity line of a foreign property's page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the provider's name
ts-kind-foreign-entity:
Identity line of a foreign entity of another type.

Parameters:
* $1 - the provider's name
ts-kind-domain: Chip on a Domain page's identity line: the namespace.
ts-kind-keyword: Chip on a Keyword page's identity line: the namespace.
ts-kind-notation: Chip on a Notation page's identity line: the namespace.
ts-kind-entity: Chip on the identity line of a keyed entity of an unknown type.
ts-kind-keyed: Identity line of a keyed entity (a domain, keyword or notation), whose ID is its key and which no provider minted (ADR 0017 §1).
ts-adopted-from:
Identity line of a local entity on a tenant that was adopted from another wiki.

Parameters:
* $1 - the source wiki's URL
ts-terms-no-description: Shown under an entity's title when it has no description in the reader's languages.
ts-terms-aliases: Label before an entity's aliases under its title.
ts-edit-terms: Button beside an entity's description and aliases that opens the term editor. Shown only with JavaScript, to a signed-in viewer who may edit.
ts-edit-terms-label: Accessible name of the term editor's button; begins with the button's visible text (ts-edit-terms).
ts-edit-in-language:
Above the term editor: the language its terms are in.

Parameters:
* $1 - the language's name in the interface language, for example "English" (the code where the browser does not know the name)
ts-edit-label: Label of the label field in the term editor.
ts-edit-description: Label of the description field in the term editor.
ts-edit-aliases: Label of the aliases field in the term editor.
ts-edit-aliases-help: Help under the aliases field of the term editor, a box with one alias on each line.
ts-edit-saving: The save button's text while the edit is being saved.
ts-edit-cancel: Button that closes an editor without saving.
ts-edit-conflict: Error in an editor when the entity changed after editing began (an edit conflict), so nothing was saved.
ts-edit-reload: Button after an edit conflict that opens the editor again on the current version.
ts-edit-failed:
Error in an editor when the API refused the save.

Parameters:
* $1 - the API's reason, in English
ts-edit-group: Button beside a statement group's property that opens the group editor. Shown only with JavaScript, to a signed-in viewer who may edit.
ts-edit-group-label:
Accessible name of the group editor's button; begins with its visible text (ts-edit-group).

Parameters:
* $1 - the property's label
ts-edit-add-statement: Button at the end of an entity's statements that adds a statement for a property the entity does not use yet.
ts-edit-add-value: Button in the group editor that adds another value for the property.
ts-edit-remove-value: Button in the group editor that marks a value for removal on save.
ts-edit-removed: In the group editor, in place of a value marked for removal.
ts-edit-undo-remove: Button that takes back a value's removal before saving.
ts-edit-rank: Accessible name of a value's rank menu.
ts-edit-rank-preferred: Rank menu option: preferred rank, which makes the value a best value (ADR 0003 §4).
ts-edit-snaktype: Accessible name of the menu choosing between a value, an unknown value and no value.
ts-edit-snaktype-value: Option: the statement has a value, entered beside.
ts-edit-snaktype-somevalue: Option: there is a value, but it is not known (Wikibase's somevalue).
ts-edit-snaktype-novalue: Option: there is no value (Wikibase's novalue).
ts-edit-language: Label and placeholder of a monolingual text's language field.
ts-edit-amount: Label and placeholder of a quantity's amount field.
ts-edit-unit: Label and placeholder of a quantity's unit search.
ts-edit-latitude: Label and placeholder of a coordinate's latitude field.
ts-edit-longitude: Label and placeholder of a coordinate's longitude field.
ts-edit-time-help: Description of a time field: the forms it takes.
ts-edit-time-placeholder: Placeholder of a time field, an example date in its form. Keep the digits and hyphens.
ts-edit-qualifiers: Heading of a value's qualifiers in the group editor.
ts-edit-add-qualifier: Button that adds a qualifier to a value, after choosing its property.
ts-edit-references: Heading of a value's sources (references) in the group editor.
ts-edit-add-reference: Button that adds a source to a value, after choosing its first property.
ts-edit-add-reference-snak: Button that adds another property to a source.
ts-edit-remove-reference: Button that removes a source from a value.
ts-edit-remove: Button that removes a qualifier or a source's property.
ts-edit-remove-snak:
Accessible name of the remove button of a qualifier or a source's property.

Parameters:
* $1 - the property's label
ts-edit-search-entity: Placeholder of an item search in the editors.
ts-edit-search-property: Placeholder of a property search in the editors.
ts-edit-unsupported: In the group editor for a value of a data type the site cannot edit yet; the value is kept as it is.
ts-edit-need-value: Error after "{property} {n}:" when a value is empty. Starts lower case because it follows a colon.
ts-edit-need-entity: Error after "{property} {n}:" when no item was chosen.
ts-edit-need-monolingual: Error after "{property} {n}:" when a monolingual text lacks its text or a language code.
ts-edit-need-number: Error after "{property} {n}:" when a quantity's amount is not a number.
ts-edit-need-time: Error after "{property} {n}:" when a time is not in a form the editor reads.
ts-edit-need-coordinate: Error after "{property} {n}:" when a coordinate is out of range.
ts-values-count:
The number of values in a statement group.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number
ts-group-empty: Shown in a statement group with no values.
ts-statements-none: Shown on the Statements tab of an entity with no statements.
ts-identifiers-none: Shown on the Identifiers tab of an entity with no identifiers.
ts-sitelinks-none: Shown on the Sitelinks tab of an entity with no sitelinks.
ts-references:
Heading of a statement's references, which open on click.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of references
ts-rank-preferred: Chip on a statement with preferred rank.
ts-rank-deprecated: Chip on a statement with deprecated rank.
ts-chip-local: The Local chip (ADR 0010 §2): made on this instance.
ts-chip-corrected: The Corrected here chip (ADR 0003 §4): a local correction of a mirrored value.
ts-best-value: The Best value badge (ADR 0003 §4, §9) on a statement of preferred rank: the value queries and infoboxes use.
ts-best-value-tip: Tooltip of the Best value badge (ADR 0003 §4). Truthy triples hold only the best values, so this is what queries and infoboxes see.
ts-fold-others:
Disclosure under the best values of a group, holding its other current values (ADR 0003 §4).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of other values
ts-fold-deprecated:
Disclosure at the foot of a group, holding its deprecated values, struck through (ADR 0003 §4).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of deprecated values
ts-no-current-value: Shown in place of a group's values when every value is deprecated (ADR 0003 §4).
ts-show-more:
Disclosure after the first values of a large group, holding the rest (ADR 0003 §3).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of values not yet shown
ts-same-for-all:
Heading in a group's footer over the qualifiers every value has with the same value, stated once (ADR 0003 §5).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of values, always 2 or more
ts-cited-by-all:
Label of footnote 1 when every value of the group cites it (ADR 0003 §5).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of values, always 2 or more
ts-unsourced:
Footer line counting a group's values that cite nothing, shown when some others do (ADR 0003 §5).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of values without a source
ts-footnote-label:
Accessible name of a footnote marker, a link whose visible text is the number.

Parameters:
* $1 - the footnote's number
ts-column-sources: Header of a group table's column of footnote markers, and the accessible name of a group's list of footnotes.
ts-views-label: Label of a group's view switch, the choice between two ways of drawing the same values (ADR 0003 §9).
ts-view-chart: View switch option: the values as a line chart over time.
ts-view-table: View switch option: the values as a table.
ts-view-matrix: View switch option: the values as a grid, one qualifier's values down and another's across (ADR 0003 §3).
ts-chart-label:
Accessible name of a line chart of a property's values over time.

Parameters:
* $1 - the property's label, for example "population"
* $2 - the first year
* $3 - the last year
ts-series-in:
After the headline value of a time series: when it was measured.

Parameters:
* $1 - the value's point in time, formatted
ts-period-since:
When a timeline value began to hold, having no end.

Parameters:
* $1 - the start time, formatted
ts-period-until:
When a timeline value stopped holding, having no known start.

Parameters:
* $1 - the end time, formatted
ts-period-range:
When a timeline value held.

Parameters:
* $1 - the start time, formatted
* $2 - the end time, formatted
ts-matrix-corner:
Corner cell of the Matrix view: which qualifier runs down the rows and which across the columns. Turn the arrows to match the writing direction.

Parameters:
* $1 - the qualifier property down the rows, a link
* $2 - the qualifier property across the columns, a link
ts-value-somevalue: Shown for a statement whose value is unknown (Wikibase's somevalue).
ts-value-novalue: Shown for a statement saying there is no value (Wikibase's novalue).
ts-labels-caption: Caption, for screen readers, of the table on the Labels tab.
ts-labels-language: Column heading on the Labels tab: the language code.
ts-labels-label: Column heading on the Labels tab.
ts-labels-description: Column heading on the Labels tab.
ts-labels-aliases: Column heading on the Labels tab.
ts-labels-none: Shown on the Labels tab of an entity with no terms.
ts-sources-title: Heading of the panel beside an entity's statements that lists the graphs it comes from (ADR 0003 §6).
ts-sources-unknown: Shown in that panel when the API's provenance call failed.
ts-sources-local: In that panel: the instance's own local graph.
ts-sources-mirror:
In that panel: a provider's mirror graph.

Parameters:
* $1 - the provider's name
ts-sources-statements:
In that panel: how many statements a graph asserts.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number
ts-sources-synced:
In that panel: when a graph last synced.

Parameters:
* $1 - the date
ts-sources-upstream:
In that panel, after the sync date: the upstream's revision or version.

Parameters:
* $1 - the revision or version
ts-sources-retention:
In that panel: what happens to local statements if the upstream deletes the entity.

Parameters:
* $1 - the retention policy's name
ts-time-day:
A date to the day.

Parameters:
* $1 - the day of the month
* $2 - the month's name (ts-month-1 … ts-month-12)
* $3 - the year
ts-time-month:
A date to the month.

Parameters:
* $1 - the month's name
* $2 - the year
ts-time-decade:
A decade.

Parameters:
* $1 - its first year, such as 1950
ts-time-century:
A century.

Parameters:
* $1 - its ordinal number, such as 20th
ts-time-millennium:
A millennium.

Parameters:
* $1 - its ordinal number, such as 2nd
ts-time-bce:
A year or period before the common era.

Parameters:
* $1 - the year or period
ts-time-julian: Marks a date in the Julian calendar.
